units.text: # EVO1

EVO1 is a Vision-Language-Action policy for robot control built around an InternVL3 backbone and a continuous flow-matching action head. This LeRobot integration exposes EVO1 as a standard policy type so it can be trained and evaluated with the usual LeRobot dataset, checkpoint, and processor APIs.
## Model Overview

The policy embeds one or more camera images and the language task prompt with InternVL3, pads robot state/action vectors to fixed maximum dimensions, and predicts future action chunks with a flow-matching action head. During inference, the policy samples an action chunk and returns ⟦0⟧ actions from that chunk before sampling again.
### What the LeRobot Integration Covers
- Standard ⟦0⟧ configuration through LeRobot
- InternVL3 image/text embedding with optional FlashAttention fallback
- Stage-based finetuning controls for action-head-only and VLM finetuning runs
- Continuous flow-matching action prediction
- Checkpoint save/load through LeRobot policy APIs
- Training with ⟦0⟧ and evaluation with standard policy inference APIs
The broader EVO1 project may include additional training scripts and dataset tooling. This page focuses on the LeRobot robot-control policy path.

EVO1 uses the native Hugging Face ⟦0⟧ InternVL implementation, so ⟦1⟧ must point to a natively converted checkpoint such as ⟦2⟧ (note the ⟦3⟧ suffix). The first run downloads the configured VLM checkpoint and later runs reuse it from the Hugging Face cache.

State and action vectors are padded to ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Predictions are cropped back to the dataset action dimension before being returned.

### Key Training Parameters
| Parameter                                     | Default                     | Description                                                       |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧ | Natively converted InternVL3 checkpoint or local model directory  |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧                    | ⟦2⟧ trains the action head; ⟦3⟧ finetunes VLM branches  |
| ⟦0⟧        | ⟦1⟧                      | Reapplies stage finetuning defaults after loading a checkpoint    |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧                        | Number of InternVL3 language layers kept for the policy           |
| ⟦0⟧                            | ⟦1⟧                  | Requested VLM dtype                                               |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧                      | Requests FlashAttention when installed; otherwise falls back      |
| ⟦0⟧        | ⟦1⟧                      | Enables checkpointing on supported InternVL3 modules              |
| ⟦0⟧ | ⟦1⟧                     | Reentrant setting passed to gradient checkpointing when supported |
| ⟦0⟧                           | ⟦1⟧                        | Number of future actions predicted per chunk                      |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧                        | Number of actions consumed from a sampled chunk                   |
| ⟦0⟧                        | ⟦1⟧                        | State padding dimension                                           |
| ⟦0⟧                       | ⟦1⟧                        | Action padding dimension                                          |
| ⟦0⟧               | ⟦1⟧                      | Optional action dimension returned after EVO1 postprocessing      |
| ⟦0⟧                     | ⟦1⟧                     | Binarizes the postprocessed gripper channel for LIBERO-style eval |
| ⟦0⟧                           | ⟦1⟧                      | Batch field used as the language prompt                           |

#### Author-format evaluation profile

The author-format EVO1 LIBERO profile uses the raw LIBERO camera feature names
(⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧), replans every
14 actions, and binarizes the gripper command before stepping the simulator. The EVO1 policy postprocessor
can crop the padded 24D action back to the 7D LIBERO action space and apply that gripper binarization. To
evaluate an author-format checkpoint under the same one-episode-per-task setting, keep the raw camera names
